decisions.title: Holding USDC after the Binance hack selloff
decisions.reason: Every risk asset is in a downtrend after the Binance hack and withdrawal halt, down 4.5% to 6.3% on the day with no sign of a turn yet. The fund stays in USDC until a rebound confirms or a trend turns up. Buys from USDC are now sized so network fees stay under 0.1% of the trade.
